text:
Jordan (arch): Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a sidecar-reconcile upgrade pattern for on-prem air-gapped clusters. TL;DR: ship compressed slices of model/artifact payloads to a staging volume, sidecar reassembles + validates signatures, then operator flips an activation marker in the control plane. Thoughts?
Maya (ops): Do we require an explicit ops window for activation? If flips are short-lived, how do we handle long-running applies or partial activations?
Kai (eng): Idea: time-windowed activation token + idempotent activation API. Sidecar writes manifest.lock, runs apply. If interrupted, operator can resume with a resume-token.
Nikhil (security): Main concern: constrained networks -> slices arrive out of order. Embed per-slice Merkle proofs and a compact index so reassembler can stream-verify without needing the full blob up-front.
Maya (ops): :100: agree on streaming verification. Where should signature verification live — sidecar or central verifier? Sidecar preferred for air-gapped.
Jordan (arch): Sidecar-only verification + offline signer (customer-managed KMS/HSM). But operator needs readable diffs for approvals. Proposal: include a small human-readable diff-manifest with file-level changes + content hashes.
Eli (eng-runtime): Example manifest header + operator cmd snippet: ```bash
# manifest (first slice header)
{
  "bundle_id":"rwd-2026-03-model-x",
  "slices":12,
  "index_hash":"sha256:abcd...",
  "activation_window":"2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-01T00:30Z"
}
# operator resume
rwdctl sidecar resume --bundle rwd-2026-03-model-x
```
Maya (ops): Edge: rollback. If activation fails mid-apply, sidecar should write a tombstone and revert to previous symlinked image. We need an atomic symlink swap and pre-activation snapshot.
Jordan (arch): Agreed. Use dual-image layout: active -> vN, staging -> vN+1. Activation = atomic rename + fsync. Record pre-activation metadata so we can fast-rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: staging checksum mismatch on slice 7 for cluster eu-onprem-2 :warning:
Nikhil (security): Add partial-fetch retry with exponential backoff. Also expose a manual 'mark-slice-bad' so operator can re-ingest that slice if transport corrupted it.
Maya (ops): UX: `rwdctl status --bundle` should show staged diffs, verification progress, and ETA for activation. We must avoid long-lived partial state visible to consumers.
Jordan (arch): Next steps: I'll draft an RFC with sequence diagrams and a small state machine for sidecar states: standby -> fetching -> verifying -> reassembling -> ready -> activating -> rollback. Ping me if you want to review.
Kai (eng): I'll review. Also recommend a tabletop run for powercut during activation (simulate fsync failure).
Maya (ops): One more: operator opt-in for pre-validation hooks (run quick smoke tests against reassembled model in a sandbox namespace before activation).
Jordan (arch): Good call. Add pre-activation smoke -> if smoke fails, sidecar flips to 'quarantine' and emits diagnostics bundle for on-site troubleshooting.
Eli (eng-runtime): Minor: size of index manifest should be kept tiny (<<1% of bundle) so it can be transported via USB or scp easily. Use compressed CBOR for index payload.
Nikhil (security): Also add quorum verification mode for high-security customers: require signatures from both vendor and customer-signer before activation.
Maya (ops): Sounds solid. Jordan — assign owners and I'll schedule a 30m review next week. :calendar:
